resource_group_name.title: Resource Group Name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the disk encryption set.

enable_telemetry.title: Enable Telemetry
enable_telemetry.description: This variable controls whether or not telemetry is enabled for the module. For more information see <https://aka.ms/avm/telemetryinfo>. If it is set to false, then no telemetry will be collected.

encryption_type.title: Encryption Type
encryption_type.description: The type of encryption to be used. Allowed Values are'EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey', 'EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys' and 'ConfidentialVmEncryptedWithCustomerKey'.

key_vault_role_assignment_enabled.title: Key Vault Role Assignment Enabled
key_vault_role_assignment_enabled.description: Whether to create a role assignment for the Key Vault. Set to `false` if you are using access policies instead of role assignments.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Controls the Resource Lock configuration for this resource. The following properties can be specified:  - `kind` - (Required) The type of lock. Possible values are `\"CanNotDelete\"` and `\"ReadOnly\"`. - `name` - (Optional) The name of the lock. If not specified, a name will be generated based on the `kind` value. Changing this forces the creation of a new resource.

managed_identities.title: Managed Identities
managed_identities.description: Controls the Managed Identity configuration on this resource. The following properties can be specified:  - `system_assigned` - (Optional) Specifies if the System Assigned Managed Identity should be enabled. - `user_assigned_resource_ids` - (Optional) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity resource IDs to be assigned to this resource.  Example Input:  ```hcl managed_identities = {   system_assigned = true } ```

key_vault_key_id.title: Key Vault Key Id
key_vault_key_id.description: The Key Vault Key ID used for encryption.

location.title: Location
location.description: Azure region where the resource should be deployed.

auto_key_rotation_enabled.title: Auto Key Rotation Enabled
auto_key_rotation_enabled.description: Whether or not auto key rotation is enabled for the encryption set.

federated_client_id.title: Federated Client Id
federated_client_id.description: Multi-tenant application client id to access key vault in a different tenant.

managed_hsm_key_id.title: Managed Hsm Key Id
managed_hsm_key_id.description: The Managed HSM Key ID used for encryption.

key_vault_resource_id.title: Key Vault Resource Id
key_vault_resource_id.description: The resource ID of the Key Vault to associate with the disk encryption set.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the disk encryption set.
